name: Study helper
author: JARVIS
description: Turn a PDF or notes into a summary document, flashcards in Excel, or a spoken quiz.

skills.name: Summarize for study
skills.when_to: I ask to summarize a PDF, chapter or notes for studying
skills.body:
1. Find the file I mean (recent files or Downloads if I don't give a path) and read it with read_document.
2. Write a Word document next to it named '<original name> - summary': key ideas as short headed sections, definitions in bold, and a 'Remember' list of 5-10 points at the end.
3. Open the document and tell me where it is.

skills.name: Make flashcards
skills.when_to: I ask for flashcards from a file or a topic
skills.body:
1. Read the file I mean, or use what we discussed if I name a topic.
2. Make 15-30 question and answer pairs, one fact each, answers under 20 words.
3. Create an Excel file '<topic> flashcards' with columns Question and Answer, and open it.

skills.name: Quiz me
skills.when_to: I say quiz me, test me, or ask me questions on something
skills.body:
1. Use the file or topic I name.
2. Ask one question at a time and wait for my answer.
3. Say whether I'm right in a few words, and give the right answer if not.
4. After 10 questions, or when I say stop, tell me my score and the topics I got wrong.
